history.administration_response: The Secretary-General presented a proposal to the General Assembly on a funding model for the Department of Management Strategy, Policy and Compliance and the Department of Operational Support in 2020 (A/74/761). The Assembly did not adopt a resolution or decision on the report, no decision was taken to defer the report to be considered at a future session, and no subsequent report was requested. The proposed budgets for both Departments for 2021 used the existing funding methodology.
history.board_assessment: The Board considers the recommendation as overtaken by events.
